ocular-trauma-score.l: Initial visual acuity - THE ONLY TERM THAT ADDS [nlp = No light perception, 60 points; pl-hm = Light perception or hand movements, 70 points; 1-200 = 1/200 to 19/200, 80 points; 20-200 = 20/200 to 20/50, 90 points; 20-40 = 20/40 or better, 100 points].
Globe rupture. Deducts 23 points if present.
Perforating injury. Deducts 14 points if present.
Retinal detachment. Deducts 11 points if present.
Relative afferent pupillary defect. Deducts 10 points if present.
